opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs), exempt and excepted charities; must have at least one year of audited or examined annual accounts.
opportunities.summary: Provides operating/core cost, capital project, or project-specific activity grants up to £100,000. Applications are accepted all year round with no deadline.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs), exempt and excepted charities; must have at least one year of audited or examined annual accounts; additionally, must have annual income over £1 million or total project/capital cost over £1 million.
opportunities.summary: Major grants for operating/core costs, capital projects, or specific activities of £100,000+; applications accepted year‑round via an expression of interest with no deadline.
